name: Glam AI
description_en:
Glam AI combines image creation, photo-based transformations, image-to-video effects and predefined styles for social and campaign content. Its about page describes a move from a consumer filter app to a broader creative engine.

The original glam.ai entry returned an onboarding shell; substantive research uses Glam-branded pages at web.getglam.app. The multi-model and trend workflow is documented, but generated identity fidelity and commercial outcomes were not tested.
description_zh:
Glam AI 结合图片生成、照片转换、图生视频及预设风格，面向社交和活动内容；介绍页称从消费滤镜应用发展为创意引擎。

原 glam.ai 仅返回引导壳，实质研究使用 web.getglam.app 的 Glam 页面。多模型及趋势流程有文档，但身份保真和商业结果未测。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload an authorized photo and use reference/styles for a new look.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传授权照片并用参考/风格生成新造型。

core_features.explanation_en: Create images or apply image-to-video filters within the service.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在服务内生成图片或图生视频效果。

en: Evaluate an authorized portrait style and short animated variant.
zh: 评估授权肖像风格及短动态版本。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm account/plan/data terms and compare an authorized source photo against each generated variation.
steps.zh: 确认账户/套餐/数据条款，并逐个对照授权原照与版本。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Subscription/model credits and optional extra-credit packs; actual quote absent.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: No plan amount established. Model/duration/resolution credits, cycle-expiring subscription balance, ninety-day extra credits, eligible-model unlimited with dynamic speed/concurrency; conditional refunds.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 金额未定，按模型/时长/尺寸耗额，订阅周期到期，额外 90 天；指定模型不限受动态速度/并行限制，退款有条件。

sources.title: About Glam.AI | From Viral Filters to Creative Engine | Glam.AI
sources.research_notes_en: Official Glam.AI about page on web.getglam.app explains evolution from filter app into image/video creative engine. Original glam.ai response was onboarding shell.

sources.title: Glam AI: Video & Photo Editor
sources.research_notes_en: No actual plan amounts in returned pricing document; model-dependent credits, cycle expiry, extra-credit ninety-day expiry, conditional web refunds and dynamic unlimited concurrency.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.en: For an illustrative creator portrait, compare facial features, skin details, garment boundaries and background artifacts with the source. A testimonial saying identity stays locked is not a measured guarantee. Test motion separately: a plausible still may become distorted in animation. Retain original assets and obtain the depicted person’s authorization.
sections.zh: 例如创作者肖像，应对照原图核五官、皮肤、衣物边缘及背景。客户称身份锁定不是测量保证，静图合理也可能动态失真，需分开试验并保留原图及人物许可。

sections.title_en: Budget by model and credit cycle
sections.title_zh: 按模型及额度周期预算
sections.en: The price response contains no readable plan amounts. It says cost varies by model, duration and resolution; subscription credits expire each cycle without rollover, while extra credits last ninety days. Monthly resets follow the purchase date; annual subscriptions refresh every thirty days. Exact model rates, plan amount and applicable taxes require the actual selected offer.
sections.zh: 价格响应无可读套餐金额，称消耗按模型/时长/分辨率，订阅额度各周期到期不结转，额外额度 90 天；月订阅按购买日重置，年订阅每 30 天刷新。模型费率、金额及税需实际所选报价。

sections.title_zh: 不限按模型且受速度限制
sections.en: The one-year offer applies to named eligible models while the subscription remains active; other models can have different access periods. Unlimited jobs use the standard queue and may face dynamic speed/concurrency limits, while credit jobs receive priority. Refund language is conditional on a checkout guarantee, usage and qualifying circumstances; it is not an unconditional fourteen-day refund.
sections.zh: 一年不限仅适用指定合格模型并须订阅有效，其他模型可有不同期限。不限任务标准队列且速度/并行动态限制，额度任务优先。退款需结算保证、用量及合格情况，不是无条件 14 天退。

sections.title_en: Pilot the actual account and plan
sections.en: Evaluate one authorized photo, one style variant and one motion result before regular production. The about/pricing pages support Glam branding across the getglam host, but do not prove every account or purchase channel shares entitlements. No login, photo upload, generation, MCP connection or export was executed. Data retention, likeness terms and output rights remain unverified.
sections.zh: 常规生产前先试授权照片、一个风格及动态结果。介绍/价格页支持 getglam 域的 Glam 品牌，但不证明各账户/购买渠道权益相同。本文未登录、上传、生成、连接 MCP 或导出，保留、肖像及输出权利未核。

research_gaps: Substantive sources use web.getglam.app; original glam.ai response was only onboarding shell.
No plan amount, account entitlement, generation, output rights, retention, license or self-hosting verified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
